summary:
I fixed all 7 W3a review findings in the admin frontend and rejected none. R5 and R7 are only partly fixed on the client: they still need backend changes in W1's route file (see needsOtherFiles).

- **R1 (TEST card machine at the till):** confirmed. pos/page.tsx now shows a red banner when terminal.enabled && driver==='test': "TEST card machine is ON at the till — card sales are recorded as paid but no card is charged". The hub PosCard (connectors/page.tsx) shows the same alert. TerminalSetup.tsx shows an inline warning under "Shown at the till". Saving asks for confirm() when the result is enabled with driver 'test' and either of those two values changed.
- **R2 (onboarding resets GST):** confirmed. When editing a brand with no province, the select now opens on "Not set — pick the province" instead of 'SD'. Province and tax rates are sent only when the user actually changed the province (provinceTouched) and it differs from the stored value. Re-saving without touching it sends no province or rates. The rates panel shows the brand's current rates (Concept now types taxRateCash/taxRateCard). If a province change would change those rates, an inline alert explains it and save asks for confirm() showing old and new rates. Creating a new brand still sends the province's default rates.
- **R3 (numbers clamped on every keystroke):** confirmed for syncTimeoutMs, maxAgeHours, chargeTimeoutSec and pollMs. A new RangeNumberInput in ui.tsx keeps the typed text and passes a value up only when it is a whole number inside the range. Otherwise it shows "Enter a whole number from X to Y" and Save is disabled in FiscalSetup and TerminalSetup.
- **R4 (controls hidden when reporting is not required):** confirmed. I checked the backend: only creating new documents checks the switch, so pending and failed documents keep filing while the connector is live. When reporting is not required and (fiscal.enabled or open documents > 0), FiscalSetup now shows a banner listing held, waiting, pending, failed and file-by-hand counts and what happens to each, plus the GoLive card (Switch off; its subtitle changes) and, if anything is held, the Release card. The "Not required" dialog shows the open counts and says they are left as they are, not deleted or skipped.
- **R5 (portfolio view mixes companies):** confirmed. The list rows carry no tenantId, so I could not add a real Company column. Instead, in portfolio view:
  - The header text is corrected to say the lists span every company.
  - Submissions and Card charges show an info banner.
  - Rows whose conceptId is not one of the active company's brands, or whose terminalId is not one of its card machines, get an "Other company" badge and lose Retry, Record manual filing, Resolve, Reverse and simulate. The same applies in the document drawer.
  - Limitation: a document of the active company's deleted brand also reads as "Other company". That only hides actions in portfolio view, so it fails safe.
- **R6 (Resolve offered where it always fails; counters):** confirmed.
  - New canResolveCharge copies resolveTerminalCharge's conditions: kind must be 'charge', and either status is 'unknown', or status is 'needs_attention' with no approvalRef and no payment.
  - Refund rows show "check the machine's refund list…" text instead of buttons.
  - The Pending counter now reads "incl. sending now".
  - "Filed today" opens Submissions filtered to status 'filed' and today's date (Pakistan time); its label says the count includes filings by hand. The list filters on created date, not filed date, so it can still differ slightly from the count.
- **R7 (bad POS IDs):** confirmed. The brand POS ID inputs now accept only empty or 1..2147483647. A bad field gets a red border and inline error, Save is disabled, and the message names the brand. I removed maxLength so a pasted over-long ID is flagged rather than silently cut short.
tests: Admin typecheck (`cd frontend/admin && npx tsc --noEmit -p .`) passes clean after all changes. ESLint was not run: admin has no eslint.config for ESLint v10. I added no backend tests and did not re-run the backend vitest suites: every change is admin frontend, and W3a owns no backend files or tests. next build and next dev were not run, as instructed.
needsOtherFiles:
For the W1 owner, file backend/src/modules/connectors/routes.ts:

(1) R5: bind the two list routes to the active company, the same way GET /connectors already is, so the whole POS connector page shows one company:
- GET /fiscal/documents: replace `const scope = await scopeTenantWhere(req, 'read')` with `const tenantId = activeTenantId(req, 'the POS connector belongs to one company'); const scope = { tenantId }`. Change `conceptWhere(req, q.conceptId, 'read')` so a foreign conceptId still gives 404/empty, for example `...(q.conceptId && { conceptId: q.conceptId })` after `assertConceptOwned(req, q.conceptId, 'read')` plus the tenantId filter. Change `counts: await fiscalCounts(tenantIdsOf(scope))` to `fiscalCounts([tenantId])`.
- GET /terminal/charges: replace `...(await scopeTenantWhere(req, 'read'))` with `tenantId: activeTenantId(req, 'the POS connector belongs to one company')`.
- Also add tenantId to the select and items of both routes, so the client can tell companies apart without guessing from brand and machine ids.
- Two-company test: in portfolio view (x-servd-portfolio: 1), company A's operator gets no company B rows from either list.

(2) R7: in PUT /fiscal/brand-pos-ids change both `z.number().int().positive().nullable()` to `z.number().int().positive().max(2147483647).nullable()`, so an out-of-range ID gets a 422 instead of a Postgres INT overflow 500.

No other files are needed: the R1–R6 frontend fixes are complete within my files.
deviations:
- R5: the reviewer suggested a Company column. The list rows carry no tenantId and I cannot change W1's routes, so instead, in portfolio view only, I mark rows whose brand or card machine is not the active company's as "Other company" and hide their actions. The proper fix (W1 binding the lists to activeTenantId) is requested in needsOtherFiles.
- R6: for "Pending" I relabelled the counter rather than changing its link; the list filter takes a single status, so it cannot show pending and submitting together. "Filed today" now opens filed documents created today and says the count includes filings by hand; it still approximates the count, which is based on filedAt.
- R2: on edit with no province set and the select left untouched, the brief no longer sends `province` at all. Before this change the form silently saved 'SD'.
